news.title: Citrini sees a tokenization boom. The harder question is who profits
news.summary: The influential research firm says real-world assets could finally give blockchains a clear role in finance. For investors, the next challenge is figuring out which companies, networks and protocols capture the revenue.

news.title: Polygon sees Coinme acquisition as entry to payments sector dominated by Visa, Stripe
news.summary: CEO Marc Boiron said the Coinme acquisition will help Polygon control customer relationships and capture revenue that previously went to payment intermediaries.

news.title: Banks could slow stablecoin growth by paying savers more, BIS paper finds
news.summary: A BIS working paper found a 1 basis point rise in U.S. bank deposit rates predicted slower stablecoin growth, cutting ten-week growth from 15% to 12%.

news.title: ‘Wow, it’s a real discovery’: Claude cracks a 25-year NSA number mystery
news.summary: Numbers the spy agency handed over in the 1990s, long suspected of hiding a backdoor, turn out to have come from a basic computer program. Bitcoin was never on that list, and its quantum problem hasn’t gone anywhere.

news.title: Satoshi-era bitcoin faces a bigger quantum threat after Google’s new Willow breakthrough
news.summary: Google says its Willow chip can prepare the special quantum states needed for advanced calculations with about 40 times fewer errors, reducing one of the hardware bottlenecks behind any future attempt to crack bitcoin wallets.

news.title: Big Tech's AI auditors will only see what they're shown
news.summary: If the White House accord's audits are going to be worth anything, auditors should be able to choose what they test, writes Samuel Vance-Law, head of research at the Decentralization Research Center.

news.title: Traders will soon be able to bet on whether Coinbase, Robinhood and Marathon will hit their targets
Circle targets 40 new markets as stablecoin demand grows globally
news.summary: The stablecoin issuer’s CEO Jerermy Allaire told Reuters demand for digital dollars is growing across Asia, Africa and Latin America as banks and payment firms.

news.title: ‘Some people did everything right’: I lost my home in the Great Recession. I rent in my 50s. Why is that judged as failure?
Meet the home buyers totally unfazed by 7% mortgage rates
news.summary: Individual investors and second-home buyers accounted for 1 in 5 home purchases in September — the highest share in a little over a year.

news.title: Influencers and biohackers swear by fasting. Here’s what the science says.
news.summary: Fasting can help some people reduce how many calories they eat — but it’s not “effortless” as some would have you believe.

news.title: Silver’s recent 50% drop from a record high hints that an economic slowdown looms
news.summary: There’s a relatively off-the-radar commodity that can provide hints on where the economy is headed — and it’s seen its value drop more than 50% from a record high earlier this year.

news.title: Microsoft, Shopify and 3 more AI stocks that are favorite Wall Street earnings plays
news.summary: As earnings season kicks off, select tech companies have the opportunity to deliver big positive surprises for investors.

news.summary: “I have some reservations about the long-term stability of my younger son’s marriage.”

news.title: It was another great week for the average stock as market leadership shifts away from tech
